name: ceo-inbox-draft-reply
description: Create a reply-all draft in the principal's email. Always replies to the original sender and CCs all other recipients. Refuses messages in Spam or Trash. If this thread already has a draft, returns that draft with already_exists: true plus its snippet and date, instead of creating another. If that scan of existing drafts cannot be completed, returns an error and does not create a draft. Call ceo-inbox-draft-edit only when that snippet is clearly an earlier Curia draft for this same reply; leave a draft the principal wrote alone. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the principal's email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.reply_to_message_id: string (Nylas message ID of the message being replied to)
inputs.body: string (email body — write in plain text or markdown, never HTML; converted to HTML automatically)
inputs.attachments: object[]? (file attachments — array of {file_url: string, filename: string, content_type: string}. file_url must be a file:// URL from ceo-inbox-download-attachment or similar. Max 10 attachments, 20 MB total.)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.subject: string (auto-generated Re: subject)
outputs.already_exists: boolean — true when a draft for this thread already existed and was returned instead of creating another
outputs.snippet: string? (present when already_exists is true — the existing draft's snippet, so you can see what it already says)
outputs.date: number? (unix timestamp, present when already_exists is true)
outputs.reply_mailbox_fallback: boolean? (true when the copy the sender addressed was unreachable, so the draft is in another mailbox; reply_mailbox_note says why — tell the principal)
